desc:
• CLASSIC COOKIE MIX: Create oatmeal chocolate chip cookies for the whole family to enjoy (Do not eat raw cookie dough); All the yumminess of oatmeal cookies with the indulgence of chocolate chips

  • QUICK AND EASY: Simply follow the easy steps on the package for warm, home-baked cookies as a chewy, delicious treat any time of the day or night

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare cookies as is or explore Betty Crocker recipes for a new take on these classic cookies

  • SPECIAL OCCASION TREATS: Serve oatmeal chocolate chip cookies for sweet celebrations, food gifts, and everyday occasions; Ideal for goodie bags, birthday parties, and more

  • CONTAINS: One 17.5 oz pouch of Betty Crocker Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookie Mix
features:
Features

Classic oatmeal and chocolate chip combo: Combines hearty rolled oats with semi-sweet chocolate chips for a rich, chewy cookie.

Easy preparation: Just add butter and an egg, mix, drop onto a baking sheet, and bake—ready in under 20 minutes.

No artificial ingredients: Free from artificial flavors, colors, preservatives, and high-fructose corn syrup.

Kosher dairy certified: Suitable for those following kosher dietary guidelines.

Reliable quality: Produced by Betty Crocker, a trusted name in baking for generations. 

Benefits

Comforting, homemade flavor: Offers the warm, nostalgic taste of oatmeal cookies with the sweetness of chocolate chips.

Quick and convenient: Great for busy schedules or last-minute baking needs—minimal prep required.

Customizable recipe: Easy to add your own spin with raisins, chopped nuts, cinnamon, or extra chocolate chips.

Consistently chewy texture: Designed to produce soft and chewy cookies every time.

Value-friendly: One pouch makes around 22 cookies, delivering delicious homemade-style results without needing multiple ingredients.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Rolled Oats, Brown Sugar, Sugar, Palm Oil, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Nonfat Milk.
